name: extract-complements
description:
Prepositional complements of a phrase, joined by ", "; extract only: «диван для детей с доставкой» → «для детей, с доставкой».

A complement is a preposition of the bundled list complement_prepositions («для», «с», «в» and others; any case, ё as е) and the words after it up to its first noun and the oblique nouns and adjectives right after that noun («стол из массива дуба белый» → «из массива дуба»), before the next preposition. A preposition with no noun after it gives nothing.

extract-complements keeps only what the matcher finds in the working column; an empty cell where it finds nothing.

Example: semkit read core.csv extract-complements write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
